recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If maintainers regenerate diagrams during publication preparation, the MedicationStatement SVG tooltip can be refreshed from the StructureDefinition; no FHIR-core source correction is needed for FHIR-54451.
issue_request: FHIR-54451 was an Applied Pharmacy change request asking how implementers should choose between MedicationStatement.reason and MedicationStatement.relatedClinicalInformation, and whether relatedClinicalInformation should be rolled into reason or expanded to include DocumentReference. The final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution retained both elements and requested definition clarifications only.
initial_application: Git commit 84c55f6b66eedb0c7341526f2cbf4a914ec4ed7a applied FHIR-54451 by changing source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml so .reason covers concepts, Conditions, or observations that lead to the medication being taken or not taken, and .relatedClinicalInformation says actual indications normally belong in .reason. Commit cd0ae4e75773fa9c19e05ad754a6bf7a7d46eedd later moved the corresponding changelog entry into source/medicationstatement/_changelog.txt.
additional_context: MedicationStatement is active in source/fhir.ini, so the inspected StructureDefinition is in current build scope. Jira searches found no other final FHIR-core issue specifically about relatedClinicalInformation, and the reporter's post-resolution target-list comment does not supersede the Applied decision. Zulip searches found no relevant discussion. Confluence Pharmacy minutes reference FHIR-54451 in the January 2026 agenda context but did not reveal conflicting guidance. The checked-in SVG diagram still has old tooltip wording, but it is a generated-looking diagram artifact rather than the authoritative source.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative MedicationStatement StructureDefinition already implements the approved clarification, and changing only source/medicationstatement/medicationstatement.svg would violate the run guidance against source-changing commits whose only edit is a generated-looking diagram/SVG artifact.
